text:
sarah: Hey — trying to triage a model perf alert but I can't find the model-health dashboard link in Grafana. Also getting a 403 when I click the link from the ops runbook. Anyone know the canonical dashboard and who to ping for access?

james: The canonical one is Model Overview (grafana). Link: https://grafana.redwoodhq.com/d/model-health/model-overview?orgId=1 :eyes:

sarah: thanks — that 403 is what I see. I have basic org role but maybe not the team dashboard roles.

mike: We tightened dashboard perms last quarter. Only eng-sre + oncall + product-ops role can view model-health by default. You need to be in the "observability-viewers" group or request temporary access. :lock:

james: Two options: 1) Join the group via infra-permissions (permanent) or 2) request a 1-day grant via infra-bot (fast). I usually do the bot if I'm triaging.

sarah: how do I request via infra-bot? I couldn't find the slash command docs.

mike: Use the request template — paste this into #infra-permissions (or DM infra-bot):

```
/resource: grafana:model-health
reason: triage model outage for svc-model-predict
access: view
expiry: 24h
```

mike: Or DM infra-bot with: `/grant grafana:model-health --reason "triage svc-model-predict" --expiry 24h`

infra-bot: Automated response — to approve temporary access, please include owner tag (e.g. @james) or add an approver in #infra-permissions. Approval SLA ~30m during business hrs.

sarah: great. also, while I'm in there, which panels should I check for region-level issues? I'm seeing increased tail latency only in eu-west.

james: Check panels: "Per-region p95/p99 tokens", "Model instance GPU usage", "KV cache hit rate by region" and the "fallback-rate" heatmap. Time window 15m->1h.

mike: For logs/traces: Kibana link: https://kibana.redwoodhq.com/app/discover#/dashboard/model-logs and Tempo/Jaeger link: https://tempo.redwoodhq.com/search?service=model-serving : you might need the same group perms for Kibana.

sarah: I'll request a 24h grant. If the approver is out, who's the fallback? @james?

james: Yep, tag me. If I'm in meetings, tag @mike or add oncall in the request.

mike: FYI if you need long-term access for recurring investigations, file an access request in the Access Matrix doc and team leads will approve.

sarah: doing it now — pinging infra-bot and tagging @james. Thanks! :pray:

infra-bot: Request received (id=REQ-20260312-331). Waiting for approver.
